rationale: T_eff = 0.2*target + d still fits, so at the 0.45 floor only IO-path delay d can fall. With ~+5.6 ns setup slack, timing repair, sizing and margins stay inert; the one lever still trending is compaction: density 27->35->51% gave d 3.87->3.71->3.64 ns (best 5.978). Density is capped at util+30, so raise utilisation: a smaller die also pulls IO pins closer to their logic, shortening IO-path wires. Both keep the best run otherwise (DELAY 4, TD, orfs, 40/40): (1) util 30, density 60% (util 30 already passed with TD placement); (2) util 35, density 65%, still under the util>=38 failures, which used leaner AREA 3 netlists and so smaller dies.
